title: Because-of chains
opening: Follow a reason until you can see what connects it to the thing you want. Check each link against the situation, then choose a response that fits.

source.distinctions: The source says to follow a “because of” when it conceals an assumption. It cautions against forcing a psychological root, and distinguishes removing unnecessary friction from denying a real condition.
source.limits: The supplied recovered manuscript is the source. The studio scenario and checks are authored teaching examples. Local fixture activity is synthetic; no independent learner result or author acceptance is established.

teaching.sourceSummary:
Because-of chains

Follow a “because of” when it conceals an assumption. “I need to win because I need the ranking.” Why does the ranking matter? “Because otherwise the years of training were wasted.” What would make those years wasted? Following the chain can reveal a belief about identity, belonging or what a worthwhile life must look like. There is no requirement that every chain end in the same wound. Sometimes the obstacle is exactly what it appears to be. You lack a qualification, a piece of equipment or a safe place to practice. Sometimes the pursuit conflicts with another value. Investigate what the situation supplies instead of forcing a psychological explanation onto it. This is the practical difference between removing unnecessary friction and denying a real condition. A mistaken belief can lose its force when you see what it assumes. An unpaid bill still needs a response. Seeing the distinction helps you choose the kind of response that can work.

example.statement: I need a studio to record this lesson.
example.reason: The recording needs clear sound and a visible demonstration.
example.relationship: Practical: sound and a visible demo are needs for this recording; a studio is one possible way to meet them.
example.check: Record a short sample in the available room with the available microphone and camera. Listen for noise and check whether the demonstration is visible.
example.finding: If the sample is clear and the demo is visible, the studio may be unnecessary. If the sound stays unusable with available gear, specialist equipment or a studio remains a real requirement.
example.response: Use the setup that passes the check. If no available setup passes, plan for the equipment or space the recording actually needs.
